reason: Molibot is a memory-first personal AI agent whose primary user-facing purpose is retaining work context and coordinating configurable agents, automations, integrations, and Mini Apps across desktop and messaging channels.

summaries.zh: Molibot 是一款以长期记忆和工作上下文为核心的个人 AI 智能体，可在桌面及多个消息渠道中运行可配置的智能体、自动化任务和扩展应用。
summaries.en: Molibot is a memory-first personal AI agent for retaining work context and running configurable agents, automations, integrations, and Mini Apps across desktop and messaging channels.

capabilities: long-term memory and conversation context management
configurable AI agents with tools and model routes
scheduled project automations with run history
external channel integrations including Telegram, Feishu, Weixin, QQ, and CLI
third-party service connections through OpenConnector and MCP
local Mini App installation and execution inside the desktop client
